title: NIRPS Front-End design performance and lessons learned
what_was_studied: Adaptive-optics injection, high-accuracy and high-efficiency modes and few-mode fibre coupling
numerical_result: The front end uses a 0.4 arcsec fibre acceptance in the high-accuracy path; performance depends on adaptive-optics correction and seeing
remaining_question: Coupling stability and modal behaviour must be tested with the spectrograph and pipeline, not inferred from fibre size

title: NIRPS first light and early science breaking the 1 m/s RV precision barrier at infrared wavelengths
what_was_studied: First-light stellar measurements, simultaneous operation with HARPS and early science
numerical_result: The study reports selected stellar radial-velocity accuracy better than 1 m/s over the 0.98 to 1.80 micrometre range
remaining_question: The statement comes from an early sample and does not establish all-target or multi-year performance

title: NIRPS joining HARPS at ESO 3.6 m on-sky performance and science objectives
what_was_studied: Design overview, adaptive-optics fibre link, on-sky performance and guaranteed-time programme
numerical_result: The instrument operates in high-accuracy and high-efficiency modes and extends HARPS coverage into the near infrared
remaining_question: Mode-dependent precision, sky contamination and long-term calibration require separate reporting

title: Release of NIRPS pipeline-reduced spectra
what_was_studied: Public availability of reduced science spectra and pipeline products
numerical_result: ESO released pipeline-reduced NIRPS spectra covering observations from the start of operations in April 2023
remaining_question: Archive availability does not validate every reduced product or remove pipeline-version dependencies

title: ESO Period 118 offered instruments
what_was_studied: Dated availability of NIRPS and HARPS at the ESO 3.6 m
numerical_result: NIRPS is listed among instruments offered for the current call at the ESO 3.6 m
remaining_question: A call-for-proposals listing does not quantify achieved precision or subsystem health for every night

title: Night-sky emission correction techniques for high-resolution spectroscopy demonstrated with NIRPS
what_was_studied: Deep-stacked reference sky spectra and correction tests for high-resolution near-infrared data
numerical_result: The method separately constructs high-accuracy and high-efficiency reference spectra and was submitted in September 2026
remaining_question: The preprint is recent, has not yet established cross-instrument transfer and must remain labelled as a preprint
